title: Open Map Monitor Message Panel to View Pending Errors/Warnings and Alarm History
summary: Use the Map Monitor summary area’s open message panel to check for pending messages that contain active errors or warnings, and review the alarm history window (about the past 24–48 hours) shown in the same panel.
when_to_use: When you need a quick check of whether the system currently has pending messages containing active errors/warnings, and you want to see what alarms were generated recently (past ~24–48 hours) from the Map Monitor message panel.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Open the Map Monitor open message panel, review pending messages for active errors/warnings, and review the alarm history window (~24–48 hours).
access_or_tools_needed: Ability to view message panel contents (pending messages and alarm history)

visual_references.description: Map Monitor summary area showing the open message panel and the related message panel elements (pending messages with active errors/warnings and alarm history window).

steps.title: Locate and open the Map Monitor open message panel
steps.purpose: Access the panel that shows pending messages containing active errors/warnings and the alarm history window.
steps.instruction: In the Map Monitor summary area, locate the “open message panel” control and open it.
steps.expected_result: The message panel is open and ready to display pending messages and alarm history.
steps.healthy_condition: The open message panel control successfully opens the message panel view (no blank/failed panel state).
steps.failure_condition: The message panel does not open or does not display the pending messages/alarm history content.

steps.title: Check pending messages for active errors/warnings
steps.purpose: Determine whether there are currently pending messages that contain active errors or warnings.
steps.instruction: In the open message panel, review the pending messages list and identify any entries that contain active errors or warnings.
steps.expected_result: The message panel displays pending messages that contain active errors and/or warnings (if any are present).
steps.healthy_condition: No pending messages containing active errors/warnings are shown (or the panel shows only non-error/non-warning items, if present).
steps.failure_condition: Pending messages containing active errors or warnings are present in the panel.

actions.label: Inspect pending messages
actions.exact_action: Review pending messages containing active errors or warnings in the message panel

steps.title: Review alarm history for the past ~24–48 hours
steps.purpose: Understand what alarms were generated recently to support diagnosis of current pending errors/warnings.
steps.instruction: Within the same message panel, review the alarm history timeframe shown for roughly the past 24–48 hours.
steps.expected_result: The message panel shows alarm history entries generated over the past ~24–48 hours.
steps.healthy_condition: Alarm history is visible for the expected ~24–48 hour window.
steps.failure_condition: Alarm history is missing, not populated, or the timeframe does not match the expected ~24–48 hours window.

actions.label: Inspect alarm history window
actions.exact_action: Review the history of the alarms generated over the past 24–48 hours in the message panel

steps.title: Use the alarm history to interpret what happened recently (when active errors/warnings are present)
steps.purpose: Connect current pending active errors/warnings to the alarms that were generated recently.
steps.instruction: If the panel shows pending messages with active errors/warnings, use the alarm history entries (past ~24–48 hours) to understand what alarms were generated recently.
steps.expected_result: You can identify which alarms occurred in the recent ~24–48 hour window that correspond to the currently pending active errors/warnings.
steps.healthy_condition: Alarm history entries provide a coherent recent timeline that aligns with the presence of pending active errors/warnings.
steps.failure_condition: Pending active errors/warnings are present, but the alarm history does not show relevant recent alarms (or the history is not available).

actions.label: Correlate pending items with recent alarms
actions.exact_action: Use the displayed alarm history to understand what alarms were generated recently

stop_or_escalate_if: If the message panel does not show expected pending errors/warnings while other indicators suggest issues, escalate for deeper investigation (e.g., additional system logs/other monitoring surfaces).

success_criteria: Message panel shows pending messages containing active errors and/or warnings when they exist.
Message panel displays alarm history for roughly the past 24–48 hours.
When pending active errors/warnings are present, the alarm history provides a recent timeline that can be used to interpret what alarms occurred.
healthy_conditions: Pending messages list contains no active errors/warnings (when the system is healthy).
Alarm history is visible and populated for the expected ~24–48 hour window.
failure_conditions: Message panel does not open or does not display pending messages/alarm history content.
Alarm history is missing/not populated or does not reflect the expected ~24–48 hour window.
Pending active errors/warnings are present but alarm history does not show relevant recent alarms.
escalation_guidance: If the message panel does not show expected pending errors/warnings while other indicators suggest issues, escalate for deeper investigation (e.g., additional system logs/other monitoring surfaces).
